title: 第15章 猎杀狼群第16章 公安学校
content_zh:
双方就这样僵持了十几分钟，狼群不紧不慢地靠近过来。
张昊宇并不着急开枪，他对狼肉可不感兴趣，不过这狼皮倒是有点用。
张昊宇瞅瞅手里的破枪，打一枪就得拉一下枪栓。
自己枪法就算再好，速度再快，今晚也不可能解决这些狼！
要是有自动步枪，哪怕是半自动步枪也好啊，下次回城得想办法弄一把56半。
狼群还挺有耐性，走走停停就是不靠近！
砰砰砰，连开五枪，瞬间换上子弹。
狼群迅速后退，却也没跑远！看来后面还有更多的狼。
张昊宇也不慌，前世执行任务的时候，为了一个目标能守上好几天，这点耐性他还是有的。
这群狼既不进攻也不逃跑！反而勾起了张昊宇的“斗志”，就这样僵持了半个多小时。
狼群又开始靠近了，砰砰砰砰砰，又是五枪，迅速换好子弹。
继续僵持着！就这样又僵持了半个多小时，狼群又一次靠近！
张昊宇再次砰砰砰砰砰开了五枪，这回狼群迅速后退，没了动静。
应该是撤退了！张昊宇也是越打越兴奋，根本不需要开抢。
只要狼群靠近五十米内，他就直接收进空间，多少狼也不够他收的。
狼群对普通人来说确实可怕，就像现在要是换成普通人，那可就危险了。
只能说这群狼运气太差！遇到了张昊宇这个带着外挂穿越重生的兵王…
从树上跳下来，朝着被枪打死的狼走去，五十米内就收进空间仓库，一共13头，有两头应该是受伤逃跑了。
张昊宇对自己的枪法还是很有信心的，不可能打拖把的，不管了。
继续往前走！接下来一切顺利，没有再遇到大型野兽，还收了十几只野鸡野兔。

到了第一次收到野猪的小河边，天才刚刚亮。
有点饿了！吃两个包子，再来一只烤野鸡！想了想，还是不去爷爷奶奶家了！
张昊宇回到家，家里还是没人。他麻溜地用空间收拾了几只野鸡野兔，搁到厨房。
然后出门坐车，直奔清北大学。到了学校，跟门卫打了个招呼，门卫也认识他，很顺利就来到了后勤办公室。
小胖子钱大宝一看到张昊宇，那叫一个激动啊！
“小宇兄弟，你咋来了？”张昊宇微笑着，“咋滴，大宝哥不想我来啊？”
钱大宝忙摆手：“小宇兄弟，你可别误会啊！我是看到你来了太激动了。
你都这么长时间没来了！我都想去找你了！我咋会不想你来呢？”
“大宝哥，别开玩笑了！我刚从爷爷奶奶家回来，这次猎人找到个野猪群，大家一起进山围猎。
运气不错，打到不少猎物呢，不过也损失了不少，好几个人都受伤了！”
好在没人死亡，不过那几个受伤的人，得在床上躺好几个月了。
这次来，就是想问问大宝哥，你们需不需要猎物。如果不需要，就送去轧钢厂了。
“兄弟，你可别送别的地方了！我们这儿有多少要多少！价钱还是上次的价格，你看行不？”
“物品的话，奶粉、麦乳精、糖、香烟酒，你能帮忙搞到就搞点，没有也没关系。
你借我个三轮车，我现在去把猎物拉过来。”
张昊宇骑着三轮车出了大学，找了个没人的地儿，连三轮车一起带进空间。
他用枪干掉了三头野猪，两头两百斤的，还有一头三四百斤的。
content_en:
The two sides remained in a stalemate for more than ten minutes, and the wolves approached slowly.
Zhang Haoyu was not in a hurry to shoot. He was not interested in wolf meat, but the wolf skin was of some use.
Zhang Haoyu looked at the broken gun in his hand. To shoot, he had to pull the bolt.
No matter how good your marksmanship is or how fast your speed is, it's impossible to kill these wolves tonight!
If there is an automatic rifle, even a semi-automatic rifle, I will have to find a way to get a 56 and a half next time I return to the city.
The wolves are quite patient, they stop and go but don't get close!
Bang bang bang, five shots were fired in a row, and bullets were replaced instantly.
The wolves retreated quickly, but they didn't get far! It looks like there are more wolves behind.
Zhang Haoyu didn't panic. When he was on a mission in his previous life, he could hold on to a goal for several days. He still had some patience.
This pack of wolves neither attacks nor runs away! Instead, Zhang Haoyu's "fighting spirit" was aroused, and the stalemate lasted for more than half an hour.
The wolves began to approach again, bang bang bang bang, five more shots, and they quickly changed the bullets.
The stalemate continues! The stalemate continued like this for more than half an hour, and the wolves approached again!
Zhang Haoyu fired five times again, and this time the wolves quickly retreated and there was no movement.
They should have retreated! Zhang Haoyu also became more and more excited as he played, and there was no need to start grabbing at all.
As long as the wolves came within fifty meters, he would directly move into the space. No matter how many wolves there were, he would not be able to collect them.
Wolves are indeed scary to ordinary people, just like if they were ordinary people now, it would be dangerous.
It can only be said that these wolves are very unlucky! I met Zhang Haoyu, the king of soldiers who traveled through time and was reborn with a plug-in...
Jumped down from the tree, walked towards the wolf that was shot to death, and packed it into the space warehouse within fifty meters. There were 13 wolves in total, and two of them must have been injured and escaped.
Zhang Haoyu is still very confident in his marksmanship. It is impossible to mop him, so he doesn't care.
Keep going! Everything went smoothly after that, no more large beasts were encountered, and a dozen pheasants and hares were collected.
When we arrived at the small river where we received the wild boar for the first time, the genius was just shining.
A little hungry! Eat two steamed buns and a roasted pheasant! After thinking about it, I decided not to go to my grandparents’ house!
Zhang Haoyu returned home, but there was still no one at home. He quickly used the space to pack up a few pheasants and hares and put them in the kitchen.
Then I went out and took a car and went straight to Qingbei University. When he arrived at the school, he said hello to the doorman, who also knew him, and arrived at the logistics office smoothly.
When the little fat man Qian Dabao saw Zhang Haoyu, he was so excited!
"Brother Xiaoyu, why are you here?" Zhang Haoyu smiled, "Why, Brother Dabao doesn't want me to come?"
Qian Dabao waved his hands hurriedly: "Brother Xiaoyu, don't get me wrong! I was so excited when I saw you coming.
You haven't been here for so long! I want to find you! Why don't I want you to come? "
"Brother Dabao, don't be ridiculous! I just came back from my grandparents' house. This time the hunter found a herd of wild boars and we all went into the mountains to hunt together.
I was lucky, and I caught a lot of prey, but I also lost a lot, and several people were injured! "
Fortunately, no one died, but those who were injured had to stay in bed for several months.
I came here this time just to ask Brother Dabao if you need any prey. If it is not needed, it is sent to the steel rolling mill.
"Brother, don't say goodbye to this place! We have as much as we have here! The price is still the same as last time, do you think it's okay?"
“As for items, milk powder, malted milk, sugar, cigarettes and alcohol, if you can help me get some, it doesn’t matter if you don’t have them.
Lend me a tricycle and I'll go pull the prey over now. "
Zhang Haoyu rode a tricycle out of the university, found a deserted place, and brought the tricycle into the space.
He killed three wild boars with his gun, two weighing two hundred pounds and one weighing three to four hundred pounds.
